meta.name: browsing-history
meta.description: Query browsing history from all synced devices (iPhone, Mac, iPad, desktop). Supports natural language queries for filtering by date, device, domain, and keywords. Uses LLM classification for content categories. Can output to stdout or save as markdown/JSON to Obsidian vault.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询所有同步设备的浏览历史，支持自然语言过滤和导出
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理和导出多设备浏览历史
copy.tagline_en: Query browsing history from all synced devices with natural language filtering and export
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage and export browsing history from multiple devices

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以查询你所有同步设备（iPhone、Mac、iPad、桌面）的浏览历史。支持用自然语言按日期、设备、域名或关键词筛选，还能用AI分类内容，结果可显示或保存到Obsidian。
howto.when: 当你问及之前读过的文章、特定设备的历史、按主题或关键词查找页面，或者想导出/分组浏览历史时触发。

say.text: 显示我昨天在手机上读过的文章
say.note: 查询iPhone昨天的浏览历史并列出。

say.text: 把上周的浏览历史保存到Obsidian，按类别分组
say.note: 生成分类后的Markdown文件并保存。

say.text: 帮我找到我在电脑上读的那篇关于经济学的文章
say.note: 搜索桌面设备最近7天包含“经济学”的页面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query browsing history from all synced devices (iPhone, Mac, iPad, desktop). Supports natural language filtering by date, device, domain, or keyword, and can categorize content using AI. Results can be displayed or saved to Obsidian.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previously read articles, history from a specific device, pages by topic or keyword, or want to export/group history.

say_en.text: Show me articles I read yesterday on my phone
say_en.note: Queries yesterday's browsing history from iPhone.

say_en.text: Save last week's browsing history to Obsidian, grouped by category
say_en.note: Generates a categorized markdown file and saves it.

say_en.text: Help me find that article about economics I read on my computer
say_en.note: Searches desktop history for 'economics' in the last 7 days.
